title: Sales/CS Request Consolidator + Quick-Scoping Guides for Enterprise Features
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Sales and Customer Success currently funnel enterprise feature asks across Slack, email, and ad-hoc spreadsheets. Several asks are duplicated, missing necessary context for scoping, and sit in limbo before Product can evaluate. Goal: Build a lightweight, centralized "Request Consolidator" and a set of Quick-Scoping Guides so Sales/CS can submit complete, prioritized requests that Product/Eng can rapidly triage and mark for next steps. This is non-bug feature intake only (no incidents).
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical intake form is published and linked in Sales/CS playbook
>85% of new enterprise feature requests contain required fields (value, customers, SLA needs, data sensitivity) within 48 hours
A 3-question quick prioritization rubric is applied automatically to each submission and visible to reviewers
A lightweight dashboard (GA) surfaces daily queue, duplicates, and top requests by estimated effort and potential ARR
Hand-off to ENG or PM for scoping occurs within 5 business days for items marked medium/high impact
intake_form_fields: Primary use case and business outcome
Link to sales opportunity (CRM) and supporting docs
quick_scoping_rubric: Revenue signal: Is this tied to >$50K ARR or a multi-customer commitment? (High/Med/Low)
User impact: Number of customers or strategic importance (High/Med/Low)
Automatic suggested next step mapping: {"Investigate":"Eng review (2-5d)", "Fast-track":"Product-lite spec + contact CS (<=5d)", "Backlog":"Add to quarterly backlog"}
proposed_workflow: 1) Sales/CS submits request via Consolidator form (forms.redwood.com/enterprise-intake)
2) Consolidator dedupes against existing queue by org name + short summary (fuzzy matching) and flags potential duplicates
3) Auto-apply quick_scoping_rubric and compute preliminary priority score
4) PM reviewer (rotating on-call) does 48-hour sanity check and either: request more info, mark for eng scoping, or file to backlog
5) If marked for eng scoping, create ENG ticket with linked intake and owner; assign to engineering Triage column
6) Weekly Sales/CS sync to review top 5 items and confirm commitment
implementation_plan: MVP (2 sprints): Google Form -> lightweight backend (Sheets + Lambda) -> Slack alerting -> Confluence playbook
MVP metrics: form completeness rate, queue turnaround time, duplicate rate
Phase 2: integrate with internal dashboard (console) and CRM mapping; fuzzy dedupe improvements using embeddings
Phase 3: automation for suggested scope sizes and impact estimates based on prior tickets

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales will ignore the form if it adds friction. Mitigation: keep MVP <=10 fields + embed in Salesforce opportunity page.
Risk: Sensitive attachments might be shared in Drive. Mitigation: add clear instructions and avoid file uploads in MVP; provide encrypted upload guidance for Phase 2.
Risk: Over-triaging low-value asks into eng work. Mitigation: strict rubric and PM gate before creating ENG tickets.
Risk: Duplicate requests spawning parallel efforts. Mitigation: dedupe prototype and visible duplicate linking in dashboard.
